title: The Aftermath of the old quarter
author: Ines Marchetti
blurb: Rafael Ravensworth, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
